breaking.change: Each is a string enum, no longer a u32 code: JointType (fixed, revolute, prismatic, spring, rope, ball), JointMotor (none, velocity, position), VehicleDrive (rear, front, all) and VehicleModel (arcade, drivetrain). Reading the field gives the name. The stored codes are the variants' indices, so saved worlds and cooked rows keep their meaning; scene text takes the variant's name, as RigidBody.kind does.
breaking.fix: Write the variant's name where a number or a constant was: kind: "revolute", motor: "velocity", drive: "all", model: "drivetrain". Drop the JOINT_*, MOTOR_*, DRIVE_* and VEHICLE_* names from imports of @origingame/engine (the codemods below rewrite the og.-qualified ones), and compare a read value with the name, not a number.
